actions.label: Find record
actions.description: Load one record of the bound entity by id or by an attribute.

fields.label: Find by
fields.help: Look the record up by its id or by one of its attributes.
fields.name: findBy

fields.label: Id
fields.help: Context path of the id to look up.
fields.name: idSource

fields.label: Attribute
fields.help: Attribute of the bound entity to match.
fields.name: findField

fields.label: Value
fields.help: Context path of the value to match.
fields.name: findValue

fields.label: When not found
fields.help: What to do when no matching record exists.
fields.name: onNotFound

fields.label: Not-found message
fields.help: Optional localized message used instead of the default when the step fails.
fields.name: notFoundMessage

fields.label: Save result as
fields.help: Name of the variable later steps read.
fields.name: resultVar

fields.label: Save found flag as
fields.help: Optional variable set to true when a matching record was found.
fields.name: foundVar

fields.label: Lock the row
fields.help: Take a FOR UPDATE lock so a later write in this submit sees a consistent row.
fields.name: lock

fields.label: Entity

fields.name: entity

fields.label: Conditions
fields.help: Filter the bound entity's records. Every query stays inside this customer.
fields.name: conditions

fields.label: Select
fields.help: Entity attributes to return when the result is values, or to project when returning records.
fields.name: select

fields.label: Returns
fields.help: Return matching records or just the selected attribute values.
fields.name: returns

fields.label: Record scope
fields.help: All tenant rows, or only the signed-in member's own rows.

fields.label: Page Variable
fields.help: Context path holding the current page number.
fields.name: pageVariable

fields.label: Page Size
fields.help: Rows per page (1–200). Leave blank to skip pagination.
fields.name: pageSize

fields.label: Limit
fields.help: Maximum rows to return when pagination is off.
fields.name: limit

fields.label: Order By
fields.help: Attribute or column to sort by.
fields.name: orderBy

fields.help: Sort ascending or descending.
fields.name: orderDirection

fields.help: Return an empty list, or fail the step, when no rows match.

fields.help: Rows to skip when pagination is off.

fields.label: Read timeout
fields.help: Seconds to wait for a response (1–9).

fields.help: Cache key suffix for this breaker.

fields.help: Failures before the breaker opens (1–20).

fields.help: Seconds before a half-open retry (10–3600).
